image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a handmade baby bib lying on a white textured surface (likely a blanket). The bib features a white central panel with vertical pleats or tucks, bordered by a wide strip of pink fabric with large white and smaller green polka dots. The entire perimeter is trimmed with gathered light blue lace ruffle. A yellow ribbon or tie is visible at the top neck area.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and distinguish it from similar garments like aprons or smocks.
To verify the complex boundary between the lace ruffle and the background, ensuring no melting or fusion artifacts common in AI-generated intricate edges.
To analyze the consistency of the pleated texture and polka dot pattern for any signs of warping or generative noise.

focus_areas: Integrity of the lace ruffle edges against the background
Consistency of the polka dot pattern geometry
Structural logic of the pleated white fabric
Connection point of the yellow tie/ribbon
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the lace trim; AI often struggles with repetitive, semi-transparent structures like lace, causing them to merge with the background or lose definition. Verify if the pleats on the white fabric follow a logical physical fold pattern or if they appear randomly generated.
